purpose: Represent route-level questions, exact child claims, mechanism variants, and evidence events without overloading a broad hypothesis id or treating structural evidence as an experiment outcome.

trust_boundary.claim_rule: A child claim disposition changes only that exact statement and scope. It never closes or promotes its parent route by implication.
trust_boundary.calibration_rule: Only preregistered empirical_native evidence may enter Brier calibration. Lean, certificates, literature, independent reproductions without frozen predictions, and historical migrations update truth state but not calibration.
trust_boundary.authorization_rule: Questions, claims, variants, and evidence events authorize no experiment, route promotion, exact-target work, or security claim.

research_questions.statement: Can a secp256k1-specific GLV and Semaev construction preserve fixed-target relation semantics while changing a full audited relation-generation or solving-cost quantity beyond finite orbit bookkeeping?
reopening_conditions: A materially different phase-preserving map supplies exact fixed-target semantics, recovery, exceptional components, and a non-orbit cost bridge.
A reviewed primary source supplies a concrete mechanism not represented by the closed independent-cube child claim.

mechanism_variants.description: Apply the same order-three GLV scalar to every free Semaev coordinate and transport the target through the matching GLV orbit.
Replace each relation coordinate independently by u_i=x_i^3 and identify all erased coordinate phases at a fixed target.
Retain relative phases, fixed-target semantics, and recovery while changing a full cost quantity; no exact map currently exists.

claims.statement: The checked S3 and S4 polynomial identities have the recorded diagonal GLV covariance and target-transport laws.
claims.scope: Positive polynomial and point-relation identities only; no exhaustive stabilizer, solving-degree, asymptotic, or ECDLP consequence.
reopening_conditions: A Lean regression, axiom-audit failure, or independently reproduced counterexample invalidates a named covariance declaration.

claims.statement: Within the enumerated coordinatewise C3 scalar action, only the diagonal C3 gives polynomial covariance for S3 and S4 under the certificate assumptions.
claims.scope: Exact finite coordinatewise scalar classification in the replayed symbolic model; not a Lean theorem and not a classification of non-scalar or birational automorphisms.
reopening_conditions: An independent replay finds a certificate mismatch or an omitted coordinatewise C3 action under the stated assumptions.

claims.statement: The independent coordinate quotient u_i=x_i^3 is not a faithful quotient of the fixed-target diagonal GLV-Semaev relation system because it erases relative phases outside the true diagonal action.
claims.scope: The exact independent-cube mechanism and dependent fixed-target premise only; faithful Petit, phase-preserving maps, non-scalar actions, and the parent route remain open or parked.
reopening_conditions: A new mechanism variant retains relative phases through an explicit recovery map and is not semantically equivalent to independent coordinate cubes.

claims.statement: A materially different phase-preserving GLV-Semaev construction with a complete recovery map and a non-orbit full-cost bridge has not yet been specified.
claims.scope: Absence of a current proposal in the reviewed repository, not a proof that no future GLV-Semaev algorithm can exist.
reopening_conditions: An exact phase-preserving mechanism contract is supplied and survives prior-art, recovery, cost-model, and validator review.
